arxiv-2106-02086.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Singha, C. P. O’Dea, Y. A. Gordon, C. Lawlor-Forsyth, S. A. Baum. Low excitation radio galaxies (LERGs) are weakly accreting active galactic nuclei (AGN) believed to be fuelled by radiatively inefficient accretion processes. Despite this, recent works have shown evidence for ionized and neutral hydrogen gas outflows in these galaxies. To investigate the potential drivers of such outflows we select a sample of 802 LERGs using the Best & Heckman 2012 catalogue of radio galaxies.

arxiv-2401-08972.title: Hearing Loss Detection from Facial Expressions in One-on-one Conversations
arxiv-2401-08972.creator: Yufeng Yin 1∗ , Ishwarya Ananthabhotla 2 , Vamsi Krishna Ithapu 2 Stavros Petridis 3 , Yu-Hsiang Wu 2,4 , Christi Miller 2
arxiv-2401-08972.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yufeng Yin 1∗ , Ishwarya Ananthabhotla 2 , Vamsi Krishna Ithapu 2 Stavros Petridis 3 , Yu-Hsiang Wu 2,4 , Christi Miller 2. Individuals with impaired hearing experience difficulty in conversations, especially in noisy environments. This difficulty often manifests as a change in behavior and may be captured via facial expressions, such as the expression of discomfort or fatigue. In this work, we build on this idea and introduce the problem of detecting hearing loss from an individual’s facial expressions during a conversation.

arxiv-2406-03857.description: Abstract Human activity recognition (HAR) is a long-standing problem in artificial intelligence with applications in a broad range of areas, including healthcare, sports and fitness, security, and more. arxiv-2503-04265.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. Eduardo Ferreira Ribeiro, Mário Zenha-Rela, João Gabriel Silva. Agile software development is becoming increasingly popular in the aerospace industry because of its capability to accommodate requirement changes. However, safety-critical domains require compliance with strict regulations such as the DO-178C avionics standard, which demands thorough documentation. The main challenge of this constraint is not the content itself, but rather the comprehensive traceability from system-level requirements to all sorts of testing and verification evidence, including who did what, when, and to which artifact.

arxiv-2504-09997.title: GenTe: Generative Real-world Terrains for General Legged Robot Locomotion Control
arxiv-2504-09997.creator: Hanwen Wan, Mengkang Li, Donghao Wu, Yebin Zhong, Yixuan Deng, Zhenglong Sun, Xiaoqiang Ji
arxiv-2504-09997.description: Abstract Developing bipedal robots capable of traversing diverse real-world terrains presents a fundamental robotics challenge, as existing methods using predefined height maps and static environments fail to address the complexity of unstructured landscapes. To bridge this gap, we propose GenTe, a framework for generating physically realistic and adaptable terrains to train generalizable locomotion policies.

arxiv-2506-17941.title: Greedy Selection under Independent Increments: A Toy Model Analysis
arxiv-2506-17941.creator: Huitao Yang
arxiv-2506-17941.description: Abstract We study an iterative selection problem over N N i.i.d. discrete-time stochastic processes with independent increments. At each stage, a fixed number of processes are retained based on their observed values. Under this simple model, we prove that the optimal strategy for selecting the final maximum-value process is to apply greedy selection at each stage.

pmc-12444096.description: BackgroundHyperbaric bupivacaine (HB), commonly used in caesarean sections (CS), may cause cardiotoxicity and high sympathetic blocks. This study compared the efficacy and safety of intrathecal 0.5% IL-MS combination with 0.5% HB-MS combination in patients undergoing CS.

pmc-13393575.title: A case report of pleomorphic adenoma in a 27-year-old female
pmc-13393575.creator: Savanna Nyarko, Isaac Frimpong Brobbey, Emmanuel Fiagbedzi, Emmanuel Aboagye Appiah, Samuel Ackom
pmc-13393575.description: A 27-year-old female presented with a painless, multilobulated mass beneath the right ear. On physical examination, the mass was firm, nontender, multilobulated on palpation, no facial palsy was seen, and no prominent cervical lymph nodes were palpated. Ultrasound imaging using a curvilinear probe revealed a complex, heterogeneous lesion within the right parotid gland, and biopsy confirmed pleomorphic adenoma.

pmc-13598525.description: Multiparametric MRI and prostate-specific membrane antigen positron emission tomography (PSMA PET) have become established imaging modalities for the diagnosis and staging of prostate cancer. The role of spectral CT in primary prostate cancer assessment remains incompletely characterized.
